[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-o6.4.1[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Collection cards adopt the title block: album, record, and bank [/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]         [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]cards wear their species, and album and record cards own the note [/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]         [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]title from the title slot[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]On desktop Obsidian, every album note and record note opens on its [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]card in the title slot above native Properties, and that card is [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]the note's only visible title. The album card paints its title from[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]local data at once, hides its redundant H1 at render time, and [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]folds its schema to one line. The record card carries the RECORD [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]kicker, a sheet tile, and paper material, with its walk rail docked[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]at its bottom. The bank Setup card gains the BANK kicker and tile. [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]The Record Card and album card editor headers show the species tile[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]and word. Every failure restores native rendering.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]3[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]2[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]

[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202611/collection_cards_title_block.md[/#87AFFF]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Album card becomes the title block and owns the album title [/bold #D7AFFF]  [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
      [bold #D7AFFF]from the title slot[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]album-card[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]album-card: in bob-ledger-tools, give notebookHeaderNoteTitle the album [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]title rule, paint the album card's title block (stack tile, ALBUM kicker[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]with owner links, title, summary subtitle, actions) from local data [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]before the report, fold the schema to one line by default, mount the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]card in the title slot with title ownership through a reusable adopter [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]glue fragment (body fallback otherwise), update unit, preview, and album[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]e2e checks, update docs, bump, deploy, and run the album e2e on athena.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Record card wears the RECORD kicker and sheet tile, mounts in [bold white on #D75F87][/bold #D7AFFF] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
      [bold #D7AFFF]the title slot, and migrates its title selectors onto the kit[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]record-card[dim] · [dim][/dim]after album-card[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]record-card: in bob-ledger-tools, rebuild the record sheet header as the[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]kit title block (RECORD kicker with album link and noun, sheet tile, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]paper material), mount it in the title slot through the album-card [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]adopter glue with the walk rail docked inside and the first-line walk [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]line hidden by a record title recognizer with reveal, move the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]inline-title and owned-row hiding onto kit classes, update unit, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]preview, and record e2e checks (never the record-writer harness), update[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]docs, bump, deploy, and run the record e2e scripts on athena.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Bank Setup card and the two card editors show the species tile[bold black on #FFD75F][/bold #D7AFFF] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]and word[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]bank-and-editors[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]bank-and-editors: in bob-ledger-tools, add an additive kit identity [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]badge (tile plus species word), put it on the bank Setup card head row [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]with data-card-kind="bank" and an unchanged "Bank setup" aria-label, and[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]on the Record Card and album card editor (Schema Card) modal headers, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]update unit, preview, and bank e2e checks and the docs header sentences,[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]bump, deploy, and run the bank e2e on athena.[/#D7D7AF]
